user.title: Connect to your TP-Link EasySmart switch
user.description: Works with TL-SG105E, TL-SG116E and similar EasySmart models that have a web UI on port 80.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll, 10 to 300 seconds. These switches run a small web server that drops requests when polled hard, so 30 seconds is a sensible default. Changeable later without re-adding the switch.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the password
reauth_confirm.description: The switch at {host} is rejecting the stored password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the switch. Check the host, port and that its web UI is responding.
error.invalid_auth: The switch rejected these credentials. Note that if you have its web UI open in a browser, this check can be unreliable — close it and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll, 10 to 300 seconds. Changes apply immediately — no restart needed.
data_description.assumed_tx_frame_bytes: Leave at 0 to disable. These switches count frames, not bytes, so a bit rate can only be estimated by assuming an average frame size. Measure it on the device at the other end of the link if it reports byte counters: bytes divided by packets. The two directions usually differ a lot, which is why they are set separately, and the value drifts with the traffic mix — treat the result as indicative and do not alert on it.
data_description.assumed_rx_frame_bytes: Same as above, for the receive direction. Set it independently.
